title: Build final owner manifests from exact staged Git blobs
failure_signature: The first closeout staged review found two owner-manifest mismatches because regenerated index files used CRLF working bytes and LF Git-index blobs.
candidate_workaround: Stage the complete intended surface, regenerate only the final owner manifest from exact index blobs, stage that manifest, and rerun the unchanged review.
recurrence_guard: Cross-worktree final identity uses Git blobs, never checkout bytes; line-ending normalization remains visible but cannot create false content drift.
rollback: Retain the two mismatches, award no staged closeout credit, and do not rewrite the index files merely to match a checkout hash domain.
scope_boundary: Owner-local Git-blob identity only; no independent reproduction, production certification, or scientific credit.
